claims.assertion: Arien says Earth treats Step Downs and starseeds living there as fully human, but Federation rules for planetary residence can be inconsistent and ignore personal circumstances.
claims.speaker: Arien de Erra

claims.assertion: She argues ethics, values and chosen influences better define identity than morphology, location or local customs; a person’s frequency differs from their surroundings.
claims.speaker: Arien de Erra

claims.assertion: She suggests feeling alienated from Earth society may signal a soul moving beyond the 3D Matrix, while urging personal responsibility in discovering identity.
claims.speaker: Arien de Erra
claims.qualifiers: This is her proposed interpretation of alienation.
